crossRefs.note: We give thanks to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,
having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love which you have toward all the saints,
hearing of your love and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all the saints,
For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision amounts to anything, nor uncircumcision, but faith working through love.
remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ…
We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers, even as it is appropriate, because your faith grows…
but the goal of this command is love, out of a pure heart and a good conscience and sincere faith,
The grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
As for the saints who are in the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.
having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love which you have toward all the saints,
But concerning brotherly love, you have no need that one write to you. For you yourselves are taught by God to love one…
For God is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name, in that…
Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection…
But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how…
This commandment we have from him, that he who loves God should also love his brother.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: For this cause I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you, and the love which you have toward all the saints,
translations.bsb: For this reason, ever since I heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all the saints,
translations.kjv: Wherefore I also, after I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus, and love unto all the saints,
translations.asv: For this cause I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you, and the love which ye show toward all the saints,
